title: check_no_crlf return type unused at call sites
description: submission.rs:546 — check_no_crlf returns Result<(), &str> giving back the offending email in Err, but both call sites (lines 642, 647) only call .is_err(), discarding the value. The Err payload is never used. Should be -> bool returning false on CRLF. The current signature implies the caller might inspect the bad address, which none do.
